# Md. Toufiqul Karim — Frontend-Focused Software Engineer

Portfolio of Md. Toufiqul Karim Shuvra, a Dhaka-based frontend-focused software
engineer specializing in React.js, Next.js, Svelte, Astro, and TypeScript.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/): Profile, skills, experience, projects, education, and contact details.
- [About](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/about): Background and professional approach.
- [Experience](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/experience): Documented professional responsibilities.
- [Projects](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/projects): Project directory with contribution descriptions.
- [Skills](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/skills): Technical skills grouped by category.
- [Education](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/education): Academic background and qualifications.
- [Contact](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/contact): Professional contact information and profiles.
- [Markdown profile](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/index.md): The portfolio content in Markdown.

## Experience and projects

- [Esther Group](https://www.estherventures.com/): Svelte and Directus CMS platform.
- [JU Reunion](https://jureunion.org/): Global alumni reunion platform.
- [InNeed Cloud](https://inneedcloud.com/): Cloud solutions company website.
- [HomeGrown Platform](https://gohomegrown.org/): Health-focused digital platform.
- [NokshaSemi](https://nokshasemi.com/): Astro frontend application.
- [Million Al Minds](https://millionalminds.com/): Svelte frontend application.
- [WordPress projects](https://toufiqulkarim.netlify.app/projects/wordpress-projects): Website maintenance and customization.
